standard.title: Specification for Apparatus for Determination of Milk Fat by Gerber Method (तीसरा पुनरीक्षण) (Third Revision)
standard.sector: Food and Agriculture / Dairy Products and Equipment

sectional_committee.name: Dairy Products and Equipment Sectional Committee

standard.description: This standard prescribes the technical specifications, dimensional tolerances, material quality, and testing criteria for glass apparatus, centrifuges, and other specialized tools used in the volumetric acid-butyrometric determination of fat in milk and milk products by the Gerber method.
standard.scope: This standard prescribes the technical specifications, dimensional tolerances, material quality, and testing criteria for glass apparatus, centrifuges, and other specialized tools used in the volumetric acid-butyrometric determination of fat in milk and milk products by the Gerber method.

certification.description: Voluntary/Mandatory under trade and laboratory accreditation rules. Manufacturers of Gerber testing apparatus (including glass butyrometers, pipettes, and automatic measures) are highly encouraged to apply for the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) to print on glass stems as a certified guarantee of volumetric accuracy and thermal-chemical resistance. Additionally, laboratories calibrating these instruments must satisfy NABL ISO/IEC 17025:2017 guidelines, and testing stations utilize these calibrated instruments to enforce FSSAI national milk safety standards.
requirements: In case of a hand operated centrifuge, the temperature of the contents of the butyrometer shall be taken after centrifuging by inserting a thermometer in a butyrometer after taking the reading of the fat column.
Designates 'Electric driver centrifuge' as the standardized equipment term to replace the general term 'Centrifuge t' in line with automated laboratory configurations.
Specifies a milk pipette designed and calibrated to deliver exactly 10.75 ml of milk at 20°C, ensuring a precise volume ratio relative to the butyrometer scale.
Specifies an automatic measure or pipette designed to deliver exactly 10.0 ml of concentrated Gerber sulfuric acid (density 1.807 to 1.812 g/ml at 27°C) to digest milk proteins.
Specifies an automatic tilt measure or pipette designed to deliver exactly 1.0 ml of iso-amyl alcohol to facilitate fat column separation.

All butyrometers and pipettes must be constructed from robust borosilicate glass capable of resisting chemical corrosion and thermal shock up to 120°C, ensuring straightness, uniform capillary bore, and legible graduations.

Butyrometers must be firmly sealed during shaking and centrifuging using a secure lock stopper (rubber stopper with metal collar) adjusted via a specialized stoppering pin key made of aluminum or a similar durable alloy.
Specially designed water baths must maintain a temperature of 65 ± 2°C for 5 minutes prior to reading fat column graduations.

In reporting and evaluating observed or calculated test or dimension values, the final result must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be identical to the specified limit in the standard.
